description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink open source testing management platform. It generates various test reports, including test suite status, keyword metrics, platform metrics, build status, milestones, and can create a spreadsheet report of the results. The script initializes reporting parameters, fetches test metrics via the tlTestPlanMetrics class, and formats data into HTML and XLS formats for reporting and distribution.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes report parameters, handles API key validation, and retrieves test plan and project data.

methods.name: buildMailCfg
methods.description: Builds email configuration object including email subject and recipients.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI object with initial state, test project info, and platform options for report rendering.

methods.name: createSpreadsheet
methods.description: Generates an XLS report file containing detailed test result metrics and downloads the spreadsheet.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Verifies if the user has the right to access the test plan metrics based on project and plan context.
